_opening_ramp: Tier C (#307): whole-round opening multiplier; neutral tier-1 ramp preserves #293 pacing. HP captures at spawn; ordinary damage at impact; bosses capture both on arrival.
_tier: Tier A: map IDs and original_life from v83 Map.wz. Tier C (owner, spec #253): region, map order, boss picks and pool rules; the numeric curve (keyframe rate/max_alive/hp/speed, bursts, elites, exp_mult, hard_cap, post_duration_slope) copies Henesys exactly. The 210 s keyframe is Henesys's curve interpolated at 3:30 (rate 0.875, max_alive 17.5, speed 1.0375), added only to carry the 3:30 pool change; keyframes from 300 s carry no pool because map 1 picks only keyframes with t < 300 (maps 2 and 3 use their own life lists).
name: West Street Corner of Perion
_bosses: Tier C (spec #253, starting values, untuned): each boss matches the Henesys boss of the same map slot (Mano, Mushmom, Blue Mushmom) at that slot's typical_hp/typical_pdd: survivor HP = round(canonical maxHP x hp_mult) equals the slot's, and hp_mult/dmg_mult/attack_dmg_mult are the 0.01 steps whose 85-100% roll range (CombatMath.monster_damage) lies closest to the slot's touch/attack roll range. Canonical PDD/MDD, level and undead flags are not normalized. Spec #447 (ticket #452): no boss appears twice across the progression, so map 1 is King Clang (shell 5220001, final form 5220000) instead of Mano, who stays in Henesys; maps 2 and 3 keep Stumpy and Iron Hook.
_maps: Tier C: owner map order and pool rules, spec #253. Map 1 is a hand-written curve pool of its own life mobs; maps 2 and 3 use their v83 life lists (no timed or hidden entries in v83). Bosses per spec #447 (ticket #452): 102010000 West Street Corner of Perion: King Clang (the last unused Victoria field boss; its Hot Sand map is not in the game, so the shell and its final form fight here); 101030404 East Rocky Mountain V: Stumpy (its own map); 106000101: Iron Hook.

boss._tier: tier C (#452, method of #254): King Clang takes Mano's slot (Mano now only guards Henesys), so it matches Mano at the same typical_hp/typical_pdd. The encounter is the 5220001 shell (4000 HP, stands, never attacks) that revives into 5220000 (25000 HP) at its death position (#456): effective HP 4000 x 0.1 = 400 for the shell plus 25000 x 0.128 = 3200 for the form = 3600 (Mano 2000 x 1.8). Touch 165 x 0.61 = 83..98 of 196 HP (shell and form share PADamage 165; Mano touch 90 x 1.15 = 82..98); the form's attack1 (type 0 strike, PADamage 180) x 0.56 = 83..98 (Mano has no attack, so it matches Mano's touch, as King Slime's slam does in Kerning), 8 s cadence. Canonical kit unchanged: stun123 (2 s, every 15 s, 60%), summon 200/82 (Lorang and Clang, limit 30, every 10 s from 80% HP), buffs 110/112/113 and heal114 (x700, from 80% HP, every 30 s). The fight is won only on 5220000
